title: Orthogonally Mixed Sign Coding with Progressive Residual Refinement for Transformer Weight Compression
abstract: arXiv:2611.31089v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM quantization reduces storage but often degrades predictive fidelity at low bit rates. We propose a training-free, CDF-free, Gaussian-CLT-motivated progressive residual-sign quantization framework that uses randomized orthogonal mixing to promote Gaussian-like residual distributions and improve sign based reconstruction of Transformer weights. Each stage independently normalizes residuals and analytically calibrates reconstruction, progressively recovering quantization errors. The framework enables flexible storage-fidelity trade-offs without learned codebooks, empirical CDFs, or trellis optimization. We evaluate GPT-2 Large and Llama-3-8B across attention and MLP projections. At five residual stages, joint quantization preserves near-baseline predictive fidelity, achieving perplexities of 32.16 and 12.73, compared with full-precision values of 29.89 and 11.07, respectively. translated_abstract: 大语言模型量化可以降低存储成本，但在低比特率下往往会损害预测保真度。我们提出了一种无需训练、无需CDF（累积分布函数）、受高斯中心极限定理启发的渐进残差-符号量化框架，该框架利用随机化正交混合促使残差分布趋于高斯分布，从而改进基于符号的Transformer权重重建。每个阶段独立地对残差进行归一化，并以解析方式校准重建过程，逐步恢复量化误差。该框架无需学习码本、经验CDF或网格优化，即可实现灵活的存储-保真度权衡。我们在GPT-2 Large和Llama-3-8B的注意力与MLP投影上进行了评估。在五个残差阶段下，联合量化保持了接近基线的预测保真度，困惑度分别达到32.16和12.73，而全精度模型的对应值分别为29.89和11.07。消融实验进一步证明，正交混合显著（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需训练、无需CDF的渐进残差-符号量化框架，通过随机正交混合使残差分布趋近高斯分布，在Transformer权重的低比特压缩下仍能保持接近全精度的模型预测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a training-free, CDF-free progressive residual-sign quantization framework that leverages randomized orthogonal mixing to promote Gaussian-like residual distributions, enabling Transformer weight compression at low bit rates while preserving near-baseline predictive fidelity.
